paragraphs.text: Yorion , the Sky Nomad is a majestic flying serpent from the plane of Ikoria .

The people of the flying city of Skysail are particularly interested in the great golden horn of Yorion, speculating about its worth or its possible medicinal purposes. The planeswalker Vivien Reid wonders instead if a rider should use Yorion's horn to pop the balloons of the flying vessels of Skysail.
Yorion fought in defense of Ikoria during the New Phyrexian Invasion .
